The output has commas, not spaces. grid.forEach(row => row.join(' ')) throws its result away, as I suspected at 14:10; grid.join('\n') then joins each row with commas. Use grid.map(r => r.join(' ')).join('\n'). And the bonus wants width and height instead of n.

events.code:
function boustrophedonGrid(width, height = width) { let count = 1; const grid = []; for (let row = 0; row < height; row++) { const r = []; for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) r.push(count++); if (row % 2) r.reverse(); grid.push(r); } return grid.map(r => r.join(' ')).join('\n'); }
